items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I had four other brothers... But Posey(?)/Jose(?), he couldn't play no piano. He played bass.

ctx.x: Oh, you had three other brothers.

I had four other brothers. Three of them are still living. But the one that played bass, he was next to the baby boy, (?), and the baby boy played piano. They could play piano. But Posey(?)/Jose(?), he couldn't play no piano. He played bass. So they let him stay on that bass. But... With Ray Charles.
